primitives.verbatim_quote: The equation fitted to the Grindley data represented by the circles of Figure 28 is, where t is the time in seconds required to traverse the four-foot runway to the food and n (number of rice grains) is the magnitude of the reinforcing agent employed.
primitives.assumptions: Behavioral latency decreases inversely with reinforcement magnitude; baseline exploration contributes fixed offset.
primitives.breakdown_regime: As n approaches zero, t diverges; at high n, t plateaus due to saturation.
